profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Applied AI |  Meta

positions.title: Product Specialist
positions.description: Consulted with a variety of customers from all industries using the Qualtrics Experience Manager (XM) software platform, providing product support to create and maintain effective workflows. Served as Team Lead of Mobile App SDK support team, reducing SLA by 50% by training team members and optimizing learning documentation. Collaborated with Mission Critical Support team to establish a Web Accessibility support specialty to help reduce escalations and provide frontline feedback to our Engineering team.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Wrote Python code to experiment with biologically realistic neuronal dynamics in a novel spiking neural network architecture. Utilized Tensorflow and OpenCV to design a CNN architecture to predict global motion of natural scenes.

positions.title: Instructional Grader
positions.description: Worked closely with Professor Laszlo Babai and Professor Gerry Brady to assess student work in Honors Graph Theory, Masters Discrete Mathematics, and Masters Algorithms. Provided student support and feedback to discuss common problem-solving strategies.

company.name: University of Chicago Department of Computer Science

positions.title: REU Participant
positions.description: Authored a mathematical research paper on the connection between algebraic geometry and coding theory under the guidance of a mentor. The paper is available here: http://math.uchicago.edu/~may/REU2019/REUPapers/Cruz.pdf

company.name: University of Chicago Department of Mathematics

positions.title: Analysis Bootcamp Member
positions.description: Collaborated with a talented group of mathematics students by conducting lectures, completing weekly problem sets, and hosting discussions on various topics in mathematical analysis including probability, differential geometry, complex analysis, and ordinary differential equations.

company.name: University of Chicago Department of Mathematics

positions.title: Housing Technology Associate
positions.description: Diagnosed and solved technological issues reported by students living in on-campus housing. Used Photoshop CS6 to redesign dormitory floor arrangements. Attended weekly meetings to discuss technology-related concerns held by dormitory resident heads.

positions.title: REU Participant
positions.description: Authored a mathematical research paper on an important theorem in differential geometry under the guidance of a mentor. The paper is available here:  http://math.uchicago.edu/~may/REU2017/REUPapers/Cruz.pdf

company.name: University of Chicago Department of Mathematics

positions.title: Assistant to the Photographer
positions.description: Utilized Photoschop CS6 to review hundreds of pages of restored manuscripts to ensure quality in digitization. Organized a digital directory of photographs to facilitate the process of delivering requested historical documents to academics.

positions.title: Board Member
positions.description: Coordinated community service opportunities for youth in the local community. Contributed over 300 hours towards volunteering, fundraising, and outreach events within the Town N' Country area.
